autonomy: --auto: approves every permission not explicitly denied
notes: Same MiniMax-M3 on the same key — opencode resolves minimax/MiniMax-M3 from models.dev and reads MINIMAX_API_KEY from the environment, so no endpoint override is needed. XDG_CONFIG_HOME is a FAIRNESS correction, not tuning: without it opencode loads ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json and every MCP server in it, which on this machine gave it nine tools freecode does not have (contextcarry x7, figma x2). Measured, not assumed — asking it to list its tools returned 19 with the operator's config and 10 without. Neither --pure nor OPENCODE_CONFIG suppresses MCP; only XDG_CONFIG_HOME does. --pure additionally drops external plugins. Verified against opencode 1.18.25.
